layer_3_action.subject: A Late Cretaceous river valley with a mix of old and modern flora
features: A wide, winding river with sandy point bars
Scattered groves of early deciduous hardwoods (Angiosperms)
Stands of tall, slender conifers on the valley slopes
Patches of early flowering plants near the water's edge
Clear, bright sky with high-altitude haze
layer_3_action.action: A transitional landscape between the ancient Mesozoic and a more modern-looking world. The ground is sandy with patches of scrubby vegetation and ferns. No grass.

visuals.ground: Sandy river deposits and yellowish-grey silt. Dense fern thickets and the first appearances of modern-looking leaf litter. No grass.
visuals.water: Meandering freshwater river; relatively clear with sandy bottom visible in shallows.
visuals.sky: Bright, pale blue with occasional wispy clouds.

negative_prompt: grass, jungle, volcanic ash, snow, deep ocean
